turns.assessment: The svc252 optical bearers (och151 S24–S08 and och145 S08–S23) show no optical or line-quality change, and other services using the same route remain healthy, excluding a shared line fault. At t=668.2 the S23 client port raises the decisive EQPT_PORT_FAIL together with CLIENT_SF at both ends; the S24 CLIENT_SF is consistent with the remote consequence. The separate och177/S03–S18 degradation affects svc299 and is not causal for svc252.

proposals.rationale: The S23 port explicitly reports EQPT_PORT_FAIL at service failure, while both optical lightpaths carrying svc252 remain unchanged. A failed S23 client optic/port directly explains the service interruption and the CLIENT_SF indications at both ends.
The S24 port also reports CLIENT_SF, but it has no local EQPT_PORT_FAIL and is more plausibly reporting the consequence of the S23 failure.
